method: Enumerated every .asmdef under Runtime/ and Authoring/ (2 total, unchanged in count and shape since P1-GATE), confirmed their references contain none of the forbidden categories, and confirmed no source file under either tree imports UnityEditor, Unity.Entities, or an MCP/LLM-provider namespace (grep for 'using UnityEditor', 'Unity.Entities', 'using UnityEngine.AI' across Runtime/ and Authoring/ returned no matches). The detached-harness compile (P2-025 gate step 3) independently proves this: neither assembly references UnityEditor, so any accidental UnityEditor API usage would have failed to compile rather than merely being unobserved.
